objectives.statement: Use hvis to introduce real conditions in Norwegian.
Use om to introduce embedded yes/no questions after verbs such as spør, vite, and lure på.
Decide whether English if means a condition or an embedded question, then choose hvis or om.
Recognize limited conditional uses of om and keep hvis as the normal learner choice for conditions.

notes: Must contrast hvis for conditions with om for embedded yes/no questions and some conditional alternatives. Include examples where English if maps differently depending on meaning.
